sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: license requirements, classes, documents, fees and restrictions
Knowledge facts: part C holds 41 fact blocks (sec01-F01 onward) from physical pages 5 to 11; part C2 holds 22 confusable and continuation blocks (sec01-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the Revised August 2026 guide, the 25-question written test and the passing standard of 20 correct answers (80 percent) from physical pages 1, 3, 4 and 20; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- MO-LIC-A-TIME — written-test time limit not printed in the guide (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- MO-LIC-D-FEECHART — fee rows for drivers aged seventy-five and older with a school bus endorsement not tied to a license row (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- MO-LIC-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- MO-LIC-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the license and permit fees (for example sec01-F34, sec01-F35, sec01-F36 and sec01-R07, sec01-R08), the online document lists and office contact details can change and must be refreshed from the Department of Revenue website.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.
